name: Report to Jennea

narrative.details:
Your knowledge of the craft grows, young adventurer.  Are you now ready to begin your true lessons?  Are you ready to take your place in the secret war we wage?

If so, then speak with Jennea Cannon, in the wizard's sanctum in the mage district of Stormwind.  She has a task for you which will open your first window into the invisible world.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Jennea Cannon in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: adventurer, I have a mission for you, here in the mage district. Listen closely, for there is no time to waste.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 15 to 16, 3,110 XP in all.

quests.name: Report to Jennea
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Jennea Cannon in Stormwind.

quests.name: Investigate the Blue Recluse
quests.objectiveText: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment coffers from behind Jennea Cannon.

quests.name: Gathering Materials
quests.objectiveText: Bring 10 Linen Cloth and the 6 Charged Rift Gems to Wynne Larson in Stormwind.
